name: Cursor / Windsurf / Cline
degradation_warnings: Reviewer isolation impossible on this platform: writer and reviewer are the same agent in the same context. Review steps execute the reviewer protocol but cannot provide assumption-blindness defense or context-bleed isolation. Treat review output as a self-check, not verification. For verified review, run from Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex.

Parallel fan-out (Pattern 2) is unavailable on this platform because parallel_subagents:false. Artifact-only workflows that need fan-out should run on a parallel-capable tier; tracked-source fan-out also requires worktrees.
Iterative pattern (Pattern 3) can run inline only for artifact-only workflows. Tracked-source iterative fix cycles require worktrees and remain unavailable on this platform (worktrees:false).
Model selection is owned by the host IDE; per-step model assignment is not emitted.

extensions.skill_tool_note: Cursor, Windsurf, and Cline load skill content via file read or prompt injection, not a native Skill() primitive. The skill_tool capability flag is treated as equivalent for routing purposes in this profile.
